bug_semantics: The @n8n/computer-use search_files tool accepted an attacker-influenced fast-glob pattern. It checked only the literal input for a leading slash or a slash-delimited '..' segment, then trusted fastGlob's expanded path strings for both filename results and content reads. A brace pattern such as '{a,..}/SECRET.txt' contains no literal '..' segment, passes assertPatternStaysInside(), but can expand to '../SECRET.txt'; path.join(resolvedDir, fp), fs.stat(), and fs.readFile() then access a file outside the configured base. An actor able to influence this tool call can disclose names and contents of arbitrary local files readable by the n8n daemon user.
flaw_origin: The smallest source change is PR-head commit 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74 in packages/@n8n/computer-use/src/tools/filesystem/search-files.ts. It replaced the parent revision's confined recursive walk, whose search root first passed through resolveReadablePath(dir, dirPath), with fastGlob(name, { cwd: resolvedDir }) plus the incomplete literal-only assertPatternStaysInside(name), and subsequently joined/returned the expansion results without re-resolving them through the containment resolver. Public squash 5476637edef52d5f3406492c764aea09725c8589 is patch-identical to this single PR member and is not the smallest BIC commit object.
ai_marker: No AI marker in the BIC commit object. `git cat-file commit 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74` shows human author and committer `Dimitri Lavrenük <dimitri.lavrenuek@n8n.io>` and the sole message `fix: Fix search_files computer use tool`; it has no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, AI-tool trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-pf2q-pxhf-hgmw describes the crafted-pattern confinement bypass and arbitrary local-file disclosure, and states patched versions 2.31.5 and 2.32.1 (affected ranges <2.31.5 and <2.32.1 on their maintained lines).

In the validated clone, `git log --follow --format='%H %P %aI %an %s' -- packages/@n8n/computer-use/src/tools/filesystem/search-files.ts` identifies public squash 5476637edef52d5f3406492c764aea09725c8589 as the change that introduced fast-glob search; `git log -L 58,82:packages/@n8n/computer-use/src/tools/filesystem/search-files.ts 5476637edef52d5f3406492c764aea09725c8589` attributes assertPatternStaysInside(), fastGlob(name), and direct trust of returned paths to that change. `git log --all -S'The literal-pattern check above cannot see paths produced by glob expansion' -- .../search-files.ts` identifies 2222fe3a6c886a9059f28e1b6d4bdb10ee420624 and its release backports as the closing change.

PR #30670 is public at https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/30670. `git ls-remote origin refs/pull/30670/head` returns 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74. Fetching that public pull ref into an isolated bare object store and running `git log -1 --format='%H %P' 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74` returns BIC 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74 with parent 06197a057d1b3155f8ca1df69bad21014c42b6a3. The PR has one member commit. Running `git show --pretty=format: 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74 5476637edef52d5f3406492c764aea09725c8589 | git patch-id --stable` yields the same patch id ac116ef5213b2aaddcba5f36dec4ca47dc16c340 for both, proving the public merge is an exact single-member squash and permitting decomposition to 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74.

Direct parent verification: `git show 06197a057d1b3155f8ca1df69bad21014c42b6a3:packages/@n8n/computer-use/src/tools/filesystem/search-files.ts` has no fastGlob import, no attacker-controlled `name` glob, and no assertPatternStaysInside. It resolves `dirPath` with `resolveReadablePath(dir, dirPath)` before recursively enumerating only descendants via fs.readdir. Therefore the brace-expansion-to-outside path flow is absent in the immediate parent.

Introduction release boundary: `git diff n8n@2.21.8 n8n@2.22.0 -- packages/@n8n/computer-use/src/tools/filesystem/search-files.ts packages/@n8n/computer-use/package.json` is the vulnerable rewrite and fast-glob dependency addition; PR #30670's release bot comment also links release n8n@2.22.0. Thus the flaw first shipped in 2.22.0, before the later patched boundaries.

Closing patch: `git show 2222fe3a6c886a9059f28e1b6d4bdb10ee420624 -- packages/@n8n/computer-use/src/tools/filesystem/search-files.ts packages/@n8n/computer-use/src/tools/filesystem/search-files.test.ts` changes `files = await fastGlob(...)` to `globbed`, calls `resolveReadablePath(dir, path)` on every expanded match, drops failures, and uses the validated absolutePath for fs.stat/fs.readFile. Its regression tests explicitly model `{a,..}/SECRET.txt` expanding to `../SECRET.txt` and require both name-only and content search to drop it. `resolveReadablePath` ultimately rejects any resolved path not equal to or below the real base directory.

Release-boundary verification: public backports f6cb6cf3ab177c3740a5ef624b89bae5165405a1 and f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f carry the same search-files fix onto the 2.31.x and 2.32.x lines. `git tag --contains f6cb6cf3ab177c3740a5ef624b89bae5165405a1 --list 'n8n@2.31.*'` starts at n8n@2.31.5; `git tag --contains f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f --list 'n8n@2.32.*'` starts at n8n@2.32.1. `git rev-parse n8n@2.31.4:.../search-files.ts n8n@2.31.5:.../search-files.ts n8n@2.32.0:.../search-files.ts n8n@2.32.1:.../search-files.ts` returns vulnerable blob 63d5a8bdb0b3a9fd59594441595e8ef8ad2d6d90 for 2.31.4/2.32.0 and fixed blob 3506505c048e7dd4586272199feff84a378c67c4 for 2.31.5/2.32.1.

BIC-only AI check: `git cat-file commit 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74` gives tree 9153f093415e50f1f22e2d0f0653d3fa1de1a448, parent 06197a057d1b3155f8ca1df69bad21014c42b6a3, human author/committer Dimitri Lavrenük, an SSH signature, and only `fix: Fix search_files computer use tool`. No AI trailer or bot identity is present. AI-related trailers on the much later fix bundle are deliberately excluded from this judgment.
reasoning: The vulnerability originates in the one direct PR member that first made a user-controlled glob expansion authoritative after checking only the unexpanded string. Its immediate parent cannot follow that attack path, and git -L, -S, PR-member reconstruction, and identical patch IDs converge on 99ca232e2d31f6e6ae69688a674d1e3425f8ca74 rather than the later public squash. The closing patch validates every expanded result through the existing symlink-aware containment resolver, and the vulnerable/fixed blobs change exactly at 2.31.5 and 2.32.1. Because the decomposed BIC commit object is human-authored/committed and contains no qualifying AI marker, the canonical verdict is NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: The unsquashed direct fix member is not public: PR #34680 states that public fix aggregate 2222fe3a6c886a9059f28e1b6d4bdb10ee420624 was cherry-picked from private n8n-private PR #279, whose public URL returns 404. Therefore direct_fix_sha is justified null. The public aggregate, its exact source diff, regression tests, two public release backports, and tag/blob boundaries fully establish remediation and do not leave the BIC or AI verdict open.
